Name: Prophet's Bed Replacement
Author: TheDeafProphet
Description:
This mod is a bed replacement and... I really don't think there's much more than that to say :P. Most of the mods I use had the beds broken by back during the bed update for obvious reasons, so I decided to give a go at texturing the beds myself. I am not a programmer and im just sort of fiddling around till things work in my save, if somethin doesnt work for you im sorry... im just a little guy.... 


Edit 2022: coming back here after awhile, playing stardew again. Not sure if I will add more stuff or not. I modified the permissions a bit: you're free to use my asset in other mods/modify and such so long as you credit me.

Update Dec. 2023: Added a new poster bed replacement. Using an old content patcher version still so hopefully it stills works.

Downloads.Description: Updated to add a replacement for the poster bed. Its green now.
